title: Active Learning with Bayesian Multi-Fidelity Laplace Neural Operators for Oscillatory Parametric PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2502.00550v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Surrogate models of parametric dynamical systems are essential for many-query and real-time predictions in engineering applications such as design optimization and digital twins. However, generating high-fidelity (HF) training data over a broad range of parameters and operating conditions remains computationally expensive. To address this challenge, we propose a Bayesian multi-fidelity Laplace neural operator (MF-LNO) for uncertainty-aware active learning of oscillatory parametric PDEs. Specifically, the proposed Bayesian MF-LNO iteratively calibrates the discrepancy between low- and high-fidelity data, where predictive uncertainty guides the adaptive acquisition of informative HF trajectories. Such predictive uncertainty is quantified via replica-exchange stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics (reSGLD), whose broad posterior exploration enables uncertainty to serve as an error indicator for adaptive HF sample acquisition. translated_title: 基于贝叶斯多保真度拉普拉斯神经算子的振荡参数化偏微分方程主动学习
translated_abstract: 参数化动力系统的代理模型对于设计优化和数字孪生等工程应用中的多查询和实时预测至关重要。然而，在广泛的参数和工作条件范围内生成高保真度（HF）训练数据在计算上仍然十分昂贵。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种用于振荡参数化偏微分方程不确定性感知主动学习的贝叶斯多保真度拉普拉斯神经算子（MF-LNO）。具体而言，所提出的贝叶斯MF-LNO迭代地校准低保真度与高保真度数据之间的差异，其中预测不确定性用于指导自适应地获取信息丰富的高保真度轨迹。这种预测不确定性通过副本交换随机梯度朗之万动力学（reSGLD）进行量化，其广泛的后验探索使不确定性能够作为自适应获取高保真度样本的误差指标。数值实验……
tldr: 提出一种贝叶斯多保真度拉普拉斯神经算子，通过reSGLD量化的预测不确定性指导主动学习，自适应获取信息丰富的高保真度数据，从而高效构建振荡参数化偏微分方程的代理模型。
en_tdlr: A Bayesian multi-fidelity Laplace neural operator is proposed for uncertainty-aware active learning of oscillatory parametric PDEs, where predictive uncertainty quantified via reSGLD guides the adaptive acquisition of informative high-fidelity training data.
